text:
OH WOW LOOK AT THAT GIRL!!! She’s in the OCEAN and her pigtails are FLYING UP IN THE AIR like two little bird wings!! Look look look—she’s making a HUGE SPLASH with her foot!! *SPLASH SPLASH!* Water is going EVERYWHERE!

She’s wearing a pink swirly tank top and brown shorts and she looks SO HAPPY and SNEAKY like she’s doing a secret dance move!! Her hands are on her hips and she’s smiling BIG!! I wanna do that too!! Can we go to the beach NOW?? Please please please?? I wanna make my hair fly up and splash water everywhere!! WHEEEEE!!! 🌊👧
